notes.title: BRING IT DOWN! Version 1.0c
notes.notes:
Hello!

We've put out another small update with a few fixes. Enjoy!

Patch notes for 1.0c


 Fixed issues with levels with unattainable challenges
 Fixed an issue where the game icon wasn't displaying correctly


Thanks for playing!

-Troy

notes.title: BRING IT DOWN! Version 1.0b
notes.notes:
Hello!

We've launched a small patch for BRING IT DOWN! We'd also like to thank our users who helped report some errors with package configuration and it looks like we've been able to get those sorted as well. If you're still running into these issues make sure to reach out to us directly on Discord or the forums.

Patch Notes for 1.0b

 Fixed issues with levels with unattainable challenges
 Fixed an issue with material rendering


Known Issues for 1.0b

 Some levels can take a long time to load and may freeze the game for a few seconds


As always, thanks for playing and we'll have more updates soon.

-Troy
